title: SBPR.QaHarness.T022 request envelope (ADR-0009 §3.2, §5.1) — M2R
description: The authenticated wrapper every control request carries. Mirrors the engine-free RequestEnvelope in qa/SBPR.QaHarness.T022/Contracts/RequestEnvelope.cs. On the server channel the helper binds the ACTUAL delivering peer from the transport and validates 'connectionGeneration' against the current bound connection; a request carrying a stale (pre-reconnect) generation is rejected (StaleGeneration) even if its HMAC verifies. The HMAC is computed over the canonical '\n'-joined field order {nonce, seq, expiry, role, worldUid, verb, requestId, connectionGeneration} (RequestHmac.CanonicalString) — NOT over this JSON — so tampering the generation invalidates authentication.

nonce.description: Per-run nonce; must equal the armed run nonce.

hmac.description: Lowercase-hex HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical field string (includes connectionGeneration).

role.description: Explicit process role; must match the armed role.

worldUid.description: Disposable world UID; must match the armed world.

requestId.description: Idempotency key; a repeat with the same seq returns the cached decision (replay).

connectionGeneration.description: The connection generation this request claims (ADR-0009 §5.1). Required and strictly positive. The server bumps it on every peer (re)bind and rejects a request whose claimed generation is not the current bound one (StaleGeneration). Part of the canonical HMAC input; the runner reads the current value from each receipt's connectionGeneration to form the next request.

args.description: Named typed argument values for the verb; validated against the verb's argument schema (closed — no undeclared args).
